info.about: Star Soldier: Vanishing Earth is a 1998 shoot 'em up video game developed and published by Hudson Soft for the Nintendo 64. It serves as a direct sequel to Soldier Blade and is part of the Star Soldier series.
info.trivia: Hudson Soft followed the July 1998 N64 original with an arcade version in Japan that November.
info.why: Vanishing Earth's only release outside Japan was this N64 cartridge, published in North America by Electro Brain.
